content.what_it_is: MATLAB script that converts an FRF (Field Research Facility) directional wave spectrum into FUNWAVE WK_DATA2D-format input files. Loads ../DATA/spectra_frf.txt and transposes it @L4-L5; grid parameters dfreq=0.0075 Hz @L9, ddire=5 deg @L10, angle indices 1-72 (L11-L12); frequency axis fmin=0.04 to fmax=fmin+(NumFreq-1)*dfreq (L14-L15, L18); direction axis starting thmin=((angle_start-1)*ddire-71.8) @L16 ('rotate 0 deg') @L17-L19. Marginal spectra Amp_Dir=sum(Amp)*dfreq @L27 and Amp_Frq=sum(Amp,2)*ddire @L28; figure(1) shows S(f), S(theta), and a labelled contour of the raw 2D spectrum (L33-L57); total energy totalE=sum(sum(Amp*dfreq*ddire)) @L61 and Hrms=sqrt(totalE*8) @L62. Truncation around the spectral peak (L66-L78): finds the peak cell via max/find (L67-L68); window sizes MaxFreqNum=50 @L69, MaxDireNum=30 @L70; index windows n_peakf/n_peakd centered on the peak clipped to bounds (L73-L74); model arrays Freq_model/Dire_model/Amp_model (L76-L78); PeakFreq echoed @L80 (unsuppressed). figure(2) repeats the marginal/contour plots for the truncated spectrum and shows a random phase field (L88-L125); truncated energy/Hrms (L128-L129). Output (L131-L168): component amplitudes Amp_input=sqrt(Amp_model*dfreq*ddire*8.0)/2.0 @L133 (Hrms-amplitude per bin), transposed @L134; random phases Phase_input=rand(nd,nf)*360.0 @L137; PeakPeriod=1/PeakFreq @L139; writes wave2d_frf.txt (L142-L153) with the NumFreq/NumDir, PeakPeriod, Freq, Dire header lines and dlmwrite-appended amplitude and phase matrices; writes wave1d_frf.txt (L155-L168) using the frequency marginal amp_frq_bin=sqrt(Amp_Frq_model*dfreq*8.0)/2.0 @L159 with NumDir=1 and Dire=0.0 @L165, no phase block.

equations.ref: peak-centered truncation window (n_peakd @L74; NFreq/NDir @L71-L72; peak via @L67-L68)
bin energy -> component amplitude for FUNWAVE (1D version @L159 without ddire)

io.name: fid=fopen('wave2d_frf.txt','w') @L145; headers @L146-L149; dlmwrite Amp_input @L150, Phase_input @L151; fclose(fid) @L153

calls: builtins: load, size, sum, sqrt, max, find, min, floor, rand, contour/clabel, plot, pcolor/shading, colorbar, subplot, axis, grid, title, xlabel/ylabel, fopen/fprintf/dlmwrite/fclose
unresolved: [peakf,peakd]=find(Amp==v1) @L68 can return multiple cells for ties (subsequent scalar use assumes one); v1 from max(max(Amp)) @L67 while ind1 is unused

Phase @L86 uses size(Amp_model) as [ndd nff] naming directions-first but Amp_model is (freq,dir) — the plotted phase field's orientation vs pcolor(Dire_model,Freq_model,Phase) @L119 relies on rand's shape matching by accident; the written Phase_input @L137 is regenerated separately with a different shape ([nd nf]=size(Amp_input') effectively), so plot and file phases differ

1D amplitude conversion @L159 omits the ddire factor (uses Amp_Frq_model*dfreq*8 where Amp_Frq_model already integrated over direction @L83 with *ddire) — consistent by construction, but the asymmetry with @L133 is implicit; the 1D file has no phase block

Axis limits (0-8 S(f) @L39, 0-0.008 S(theta) @L47) and contour levels @L50 are dataset-specific; -71.8 deg rotation constant @L16 is FRF-array-specific and undocumented beyond the 'rotate 0 deg' comment; angle_end @L12, ind1, Hrms/Hrms_model computed but unused in output
